page.overview:
Who is Lucy?

Pike Queen Lucy is the fourth Frontier Brain of the Hoenn region. She is in charge of the Battle Pike.

Lucy is tall, pale and very slender. She has bright red eyes and long straight black hair with red lowlights at the sides. She wears a purple halter neck crop top that shows off her stomach, long purple gloves, black pants with a gold diamond pattern around the waist, and pointy purple high heel boots on her feet. Her appearance is reminiscent of the Pokémon Seviper.

Lucy is cold and straightforward. She doesn't like stopping by to have chats and instead want to go straight into battles. She would also dismiss her opponents after a battle is over. Sometimes she can have a short fuse and is quite vain about herself.

Lucy appears as one of the Frontier Brains who runs the Battle Pike in Battle Frontier. In order to battle her, the player character has to complete the Battle Pike at least two times without fail (meaning that one has to clear 27 consecutive rooms) in order to meet her. If she is defeated, one can get the Silver Luck Symbol. In order to challenge her for the Gold Symbol, the player character has to clear the Battle Pike another eight consecutive times, or 10 times in total (for a grand total of 140 rooms).
